name: TCI Co., Ltd.
summary: TCI Co., Ltd., an original design manufacturer company, engages in the manufacturing, wholesale, and retail of health foods and cosmetics products in Taiwan, Mainland China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers liquid and solid supplements; immunity products; functional probiotics; basic nutrition; detox slimming; body health; sports nutrition supplement products; laundry detergents; hand sanitizers; and functional snacks, which includes, jelly, bars, chocolates, and gummies.
